dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Whoever owns this place is very thoughtful. It was kind of them to create such a perfect resting spot for us to unwind after a long battle.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Me? To be honest... My daily sword training is often tougher than this. I haven't reached my limit so far.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But thank you for asking. It's nice that you care so much.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Sometimes I worry that if I'm not careful, I might make a mistake that ends up putting you in even more danger.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Once that thought enters my head, I start losing confidence in myself about the battles ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #But I am determined to overcome my fears and focus on doing all I can when I'm fighting by your side, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Stories from other lands are something new and precious to me. I cherish the opportunity to read them during our rest time. I hope I can finish them.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Look at the wonderful printing, and the beautiful illustrations...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh! Could we read some stories together? Only if you want, of course. There's a lot of interesting details I want to share with you.
